summary: P1-2 multi-asset client dashboard — full backend + frontend validation. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass on /api/v1/client/dashboard-summary. Response shape matches contract exactly: aum={arsa:{principal:0,yield_accrued:0,positions:0,active:0}, usdc:{principal:546663.87,yield_accrued:126.43,positions:59,active:36}}, cash={usdc:0, arsa:601234.56}, breakdown=[{asset:'usdc', modality:'end', count:59, principal:546663.87}], fetched_at iso. External=true positions (8 ARSa historicals) excluded from aum/breakdown (verified: arsa.positions=0). super_admin@prosper.foundation does NOT crash (returns 200 with empty buckets, status<500). Frontend /client: KPI rows render with TWO sections — kpi-row-arsa shows 0,00 ARSa AUM + 'Sin posiciones' hint + 601.234,56 ARSa Saldo libre; kpi-row-usdc shows 546.663,87 USDC AUM + 36 stakings activos + 59 Posiciones (36 activas · 23 cerradas). Each row shows Modalidad (fallback to product_id 'liquid_v1' for legacy positions w/o modality field), Principal in native USDC, Rate %, Yield acumulado in native USDC, Vencimiento '—' for legacy. Section head totals correct (543.948,74 USDC · 126,43 USDC).

issues: Cosmetic: Labels are CSS-uppercase ('MODALIDAD' visually) while source uses 'Modalidad' — matches existing convention, not a bug.

ramp_balances fallback path in dashboard_summary (lines 285-295) repeats logic that exists in routes/ramp.py — consider extracting to db helper get_org_arsa_balance(org_id) for DRY.

client/page.tsx is now 437 lines — manageable but the multi-asset KPI block (~60 lines) could be extracted to <KpiRowAsset asset='arsa'|'usdc' aum cash /> to drop duplication.
Stellar Expert link hardcoded to public network in investments page (STELLAR_EXPLORER_TX). When PROSPER_MODE=development the actual txs may live on testnet — consider env-driven base.

rca of the issue: No bugs found. The deposit subtitle 'discrepancy' is by design: ActionBtn renders 'Disponible al aprobar KYB' when disabled=true, otherwise renders the subtitle prop. Alemany's KYB state (paused at 'Verificación de antecedentes en curso') makes can_operate=false → disabled=true. Code at /app/frontend/src/app/client/page.tsx:159 already sets subtitle='ARSa (CVU) o USDC (transferencia Stellar)' correctly.
